#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <ATen/cuda/CUDAContext.h>
#include <c10/cuda/CUDAGuard.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

// Per-shape dispatch over three lineages (each in its own translation unit, unchanged):
//   D (lin_d.cu, weight-streaming cooperative kernel): 2,768,7,7 and 8,384,14,14
//   B (lin_b.cu, one cooperative launch, FP16 mma.sync): 1,192,28,28 and 1,96,56,56
//   A r4 (lin_a4.cu): 1,160,449,7  8/16/32,768,7,7  16,384,14,14  4,192,28,28
//   A r3 (lin_a.cu, TMA conv + cuBLASLt / mma.sync pipeline): every other shape

// ---- lineage A
extern "C" size_t convblk_ws_bytes(int B, int C, int H, int W);
extern "C" int convblk_run(const float* x, const float* dww, const float* dwb, const float* lnw, const float* lnb,
                           const float* w1, const float* b1, const float* gw, const float* gb, const float* w2,
                           const float* b2, float* out, void* ws, int B, int C, int H, int W, float grn_eps,
                           float ln_eps, cudaStream_t st);

// ---- lineage A, r4 (lin_a4.cu: bulk-plane conv K1 + cuBLASLt pipeline) on the W=7/14 and 449x7 rows it wins
extern "C" size_t a4_convblk_ws_bytes(int B, int C, int H, int W);
extern "C" int a4_convblk_run(const float* x, const float* dww, const float* dwb, const float* lnw, const float* lnb,
                              const float* w1, const float* b1, const float* gw, const float* gb, const float* w2,
                              const float* b2, float* out, void* ws, int B, int C, int H, int W, float grn_eps,
                              float ln_eps, cudaStream_t st);

// ---- lineage B (layout must match lin_b::Params)
struct BParams {
  const float* x; const float* dww; const float* dwb; const float* lnw; const float* lnb;
  const float* w1; const float* b1; const float* gw; const float* gb; const float* w2; const float* b2;
  float* out;
  void* xh; float* part; void* hidden; float* sumsq; void* w1h; void* w2h; float* s
